addNotes.title: Add Notes
addNotes.description: Create notes with rich formatting, images and tables. Click on a notebook, then add a new note using the "+ Add note" button.

pinOrganize.description: Pin important notes by clicking the pin icon, drag files between folders or by dragging to the sidebar add directly to other spaces. Create your own structure and organize materials the way you like.

folderMaterials.description: Create folders and subfolders to better organize your notes. Group materials by subjects, topics or projects. Everything under control!

listenPodcasts.title: Listen to Podcasts
listenPodcasts.description: Transform your notes into audio podcasts and learn on the go. Select a note and click the "Generate podcast" option or describe what you want to listen to, to create audio from the content.

chatWithAI.title: Chat with AI
chatWithAI.description: Ask questions to AI assistant who will help you understand difficult concepts. Click "Chat with AI" on the top bar to start a conversation with the assistant.
